title: Elegant Chiffon High-Low Off The Shoulder Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
This stunning Off-The-Shoulder High Low Bridesmaid Dress is the perfect choice for any wedding. Made from delicate chiffon fabric with a feminine ruffle hemline, this dress features a flattering off-the-shoulder neckline that will showcase your elegant collarbones. The flowy high low skirt adds a touch of whimsy to the design, while the fitted bodice cinches at the waist to create a flattering silhouette. Available in a variety of colors to match any wedding theme, this dress will make you look and feel beautiful on the big day.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Knee length/High-low.


Sleeve Style: Short Sleeve.


Closure: It is no zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
